jessica: Heads-up: GreenValley (Dedicated) wants final go-live window. Proposal: Tue 2026-05-12 02:00–04:00 UTC. Need infra + security + product ops approvals. Pin model/version and provide rollback steps. @dmitri @sara_prodops @rachel_sec

 dmitri: Quick question — our batch maintenance runs until ~03:30 UTC that day. Can we shift to 04:00–06:00 UTC instead? avoids overlap with nightly cache rebuild. :thinking_face:

 sara_prodops: 04:00–06:00 would be cleaner for infra. If GreenValley strongly prefers 02:00 we can still do it but require a 30m canary with manual hold before ramp. Need explicit rollback target and release notes link.

 jessica: They prefer early morning for APAC support, but flexible. OK — propose compromise: start at 02:30 UTC, 30m canary, then ramp 02:30–03:30. If metrics good, full cutover at 03:30. If not, rollback to pinned version.

 liam: What exact model artifact are we pinning for Dedicated? We should avoid auto-updates during cutover.

 jessica: Pinning to model artifact: gv-model-2026-v2.3.1-quant. Rollback target: gv-model-2026-v2.3.0. I've updated the release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/greenvalley-2026-05 (please review).

 rachel_sec: Security sign-off pending one item: confirm KMS key rotation window doesn't hit 02:00–04:00. If KMS rotation overlaps, we need to move. Also require audit flag turned on for the private control plane during the cutover.

 dmitri: Confirmed with infra: no KMS rotation scheduled then. We'll enable extra trace sampling and keep KV cache warmers on. Ops will also pin the runtime package to 1.48.2 for the dedicated pool to avoid kernel changes.

 deploy-bot: [automated] deploy job created: job_id=gj-20260512-42
deploy-bot: canary plan: 30 minutes, 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with 5m evaluation windows. health checks: 200 OK rate, median p95 latency <120ms, error rate <0.5%

 deploy-bot: rollback playbook attached: run

```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --job gj-20260512-42 --to-version gv-model-2026-v2.3.0 --force
```

 jessica: OK — this reads good. Can infra + security react with :thumbsup: to approve the 02:30 start + canary plan? If no objections by EOD today we'll lock the window and send to GreenValley.

 rachel_sec: :thumbsup: Security approves conditional on audit flag being toggled and no KMS rotation.

 dmitri: :thumbsup: Infra approves, will schedule runtime pin and warmers. I'll be on-call for the window.

 sara_prodops: Approved. I'll own the canary monitoring dashboard and be in the deploy channel during the window.

 jessica: Great — locking window to Tue 2026-05-12 02:30–04:00 UTC. I'll send the confirmation to GreenValley and attach the release notes + rollback playbook. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
